entries.title: Plurisubharmonic functions
entries.merge_note: The same line-restriction definition, including dimension zero. Source explanations and numbered clauses remain available.

entries.title: Analytic and neat analytic singularities
entries.merge_note: The same rational-coefficient analytic-singularity definition. The source versions retain their local presentations, type notation, and explanatory footnotes.

entries.title: Quasi-equisingular approximation
entries.merge_note: The same definition in the compact Kähler setting. Decrease of the approximants makes the multiplier-ideal condition at one index equivalent to the condition at all sufficiently large indices.

entries.title: Rooftop envelopes
entries.merge_note: The same rooftop construction in the closed Kähler setting, with different notation. Both source versions retain the convention for an identically minus-infinity input.

entries.title: Multiplier ideals
entries.merge_note: One local-integrability construction with source-specific scopes: weights and componentwise minus-infinity values in Foundations, plurisubharmonic functions in SGPT, and quasi-plurisubharmonic functions in the Hermitian text. Each scope is retained below.

entries.title: Pluripolar sets
entries.merge_note: One local pluripolarity definition. The source versions also introduce different related terminology, including global pluripolarity, quasi-everywhere statements, and co-pluripolar sets.

entries.title: Plurifine topology
entries.merge_note: The same topology presented on domains and then in charts on a complex manifold. Foundations additionally defines plurithinness; its full source statement is retained.

entries.title: Singularity order and singularity types
entries.merge_note: The same bounded-shift preorder on quasi-plurisubharmonic functions on a compact manifold. The Hermitian source distinguishes ordinary type from multiplier-ideal type.

entries.title: Almost semigroups generating the lattice
entries.merge_note: The definition is repeated in the main chapter and the appendix. One entry retains both source locations.

entries.title: Volume and Hausdorff convergence for almost semigroups
entries.merge_note: The same theorem appears in the main chapter and the appendix. The appendix version with its proof is displayed first.

entries.title: The semigroup distance formula
entries.merge_note: The same corollary appears in the main chapter and the appendix. The appendix proof is retained.

entries.title: Inclusion of Okounkov bodies
entries.merge_note: The same corollary appears in the main chapter and the appendix. The appendix proof is retained.

entries.title: Bounded global cohomological mass
entries.merge_note: The logarithmic-growth full-mass statement is the affine-chart consequence of the bounded global cohomological mass formula, with the normalization and no mass at the hyperplane at infinity checked in the affine chart. Its source variant retains the radial and proper-comparison proof.

entries.title: Classical products with controlled unbounded loci
entries.merge_note: The general statement permits a positive closed base current and Hausdorff-small intersections of unbounded loci. The other variants assume a common small pole set or an isolated pole, with their narrower hypotheses retained. These classical products may retain mass at poles.

entries.title: Small pole residual invariance
entries.merge_note: The Klimek variant establishes the single-point residual comparison and the ratio case by positive rescaling. It uses the isolated-point product construction. Preserve the preferred result and its broader scope; do not infer the full small-pole theorem from this special-case proof.

entries.title: Principal symbols and formal adjoints
entries.merge_note: These variants describe intrinsic principal symbols and formal adjoints. The general statement also gives the polynomial obtained by conjugation with an exponential.

entries.title: Vector bundles and locally free function-sheaf modules
entries.merge_note: The function-sheaf statement includes smooth and holomorphic vector bundles as special cases.

entries.title: Partial-rank semipositive line-bundle vanishing
entries.merge_note: The curvature-rank statement includes line bundles that are definite at one point as the case s=1.

entries.title: Closed order-zero currents on analytic support
entries.merge_note: The general statement classifies closed complex order-zero currents on analytic support of the appropriate dimension, including the real (1,1) case.

entries.title: Compact singular-metric Nadel vanishing
entries.merge_note: Both statements give the same compact Kähler singular-metric vanishing for a fixed positive curvature lower bound and the full quadratic multiplier ideal. Preserve the current theorem and its proof as preferred; retain the independent weighted-resolution proof as a source variant. The analytic-methods local resolution and sharper L2 estimate remain distinct entries.

entries.title: Strictly positive singular metrics
entries.merge_note: Consolidate the two headings for the same compact Nadel conclusion after canonical statement deduplication. Their source introductions, proof variants and stable labels remain available; avoid an empty duplicate reading section.
